name: bandmixr
description: Mix your stems and master your songs in the chat.

interface.longDescription:
Bandmixr mixes and masters music you recorded yourself. It is made for musicians, bands and home producers.

Check a finished song: drop it into the chat and see its loudness, peaks, stereo width and tonal balance with plain-word verdicts, then hear a 30-second mastered preview next to the original. The song is measured in your browser.

Mix your stems: upload the separate tracks of a song (vocals, drums, bass, guitars, keys and so on). Bandmixr recognizes what is on each stem, you check the labels and confirm them with one tap, and the mix and the master then run on their own. Listen to the original, the mix and the master side by side in the chat.

Change the mix in words, for example "vocals a bit louder, less reverb on the guitar, mute the shaker", and Bandmixr makes the mix and the master again. You can also set each stem's volume, mute, reverb and pan in the studio.

Master a finished song in one of three styles: Streaming, Standard or Loud.

Mixing and full-song masters need a Bandmixr account; checking a song does not. Downloads happen on the song's page on bandmixr.com. Bandmixr processes your own recordings: it does not generate music or voices. Supported files: WAV, AIFF, FLAC and MP3.
capabilities: Check a mix: loudness, peaks, stereo width and tonal balance
Play a 30-second mastered preview next to the original
Master a whole song in the Streaming, Standard or Loud style
Mix uploaded stems after the person confirms the stem labels
Change a mix in words: stem volume, mute, reverb and pan
Play the original, the mix and the master in the chat
defaultPrompt: Check my mix before I release it.
Mix my stems. It's a pop song with my vocals, ready for streaming.

positive.description: Check a finished mix without an account. Use 'Demo Song (unmastered mix).flac' from the review files.
positive.prompt: Check my mix before I release it.
positive.expected_behavior: The Bandmixr studio opens with a drop zone. After the demo mix is dropped in, it shows loudness, true peak, stereo width and tonal balance with verdicts (the demo mix is quiet and unmastered), asks nothing about an account, and plays a 30-second mastered preview that can be switched with the original.

positive.description: Master a whole song. Use 'Demo Song (unmastered mix).flac' from the review files and sign in with the review account when asked.
positive.expected_behavior: The studio opens for mastering. After the demo mix is dropped in, the 30-second preview plays. 'Get full track' uploads the whole song and masters it in the Streaming style (under a minute; if no Bandmixr account is connected yet, it asks for the review account first), then the master plays in the chat next to the original.

positive.description: Mix stems. Use the six files in the 'Stems' folder of the review files, signed in with the review account.
positive.prompt: Mix my stems. It's a pop song, ready for streaming.
positive.expected_behavior: A new song is created and the studio shows an upload box. After the six stems are uploaded, the label check shows them as Hihat, Kick, Snare, Bass Synth, Synth Lead and Synth Pad. After 'Labels are correct' is pressed, the mix and the master run by themselves (about a minute, with progress shown) and the player plays the original, the mix and the master.

positive.description: Change an existing mix in words. The review account already has a mixed and mastered 'Demo Song'.
positive.prompt: In my Bandmixr Demo Song, make the synth lead a bit louder and mute the hi-hat.
positive.expected_behavior: Bandmixr finds 'Demo Song', raises the synth lead and mutes the hi-hat, and makes the mix and the master again. The studio shows 'Applying your changes' and then plays the new mix, in which the hi-hat is gone.

positive.description: Master an existing mix again in another style. The review account already has a mixed and mastered 'Demo Song'.
positive.prompt: Make the master of my Bandmixr Demo Song louder.
positive.expected_behavior: Bandmixr masters the Demo Song's mix again in the Loud style. The player shows the mastering progress and then plays the new, louder master next to the mix.

negative.description: Generating new music is not something Bandmixr does.
negative.prompt: Write and sing a new pop song about summer with an AI voice.

negative.description: Songwriting help without any audio to mix or master.
negative.prompt: Write lyrics for the chorus of a sad love song.
What is the weather in Zurich tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: Bandmixr sells nothing in ChatGPT: the plugin shows no prices, plans or upgrade offers and processes no payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: check and master songs, mix stems after a label check, change a mix in words, and play the original, the mix and the master in the chat.
